events.text: I traded my one third of the pizza for my friend's one fourth, because four is bigger than three. Did I get a good deal?
It doesn't matter. You both get one slice, so it's the same.
Can you show me? I'll draw the pizzas.
Drew two pizzas of the same size: one cut into 3 equal slices, one cut into 4 equal slices.
Circled one slice of the thirds pizza and one slice of the fourths pizza by hand.
See, one slice and one slice.
I see you circled one slice in each pizza. But they don't look the same size. Let me put one on top of the other.
Placed the 1/4 slice on top of the 1/3 slice. The 1/4 slice is smaller.
Oh! The third is bigger. Same size pizzas, so more slices means each slice is smaller.
So I gave away the bigger slice! I want my pizza back.
